author: NuclearDucky
body:
I loved playing elimination. It was extremely fun. The second game i mostly played. But lets be honest. It isnt getting anywhere. No one is playing it. Every time I look at the signs, no one is playing.

          I suggest we *gulp* *gets ready to get yelled at* bring ack sg and hg. With these two coming back, people might actually start playing them! Also, I keep hearing "elimination is sg and hg." You're wrong. Elimination is 98% hg and 2% sg. The only thing that is kinda like sg is the supply drop whixh isnt that noticeable. 

#BRINGBACKSGANDHG
